I can't stop thinking about Ahmaud Arbery. It's been just over a year. He would be 26 by now. A hate crime was committed against a Black jogger, and now Black joggers across America carry that trauma. #BlackLivesMatter

https://t.co/guCadolC8h

From Sheila Thorne's #MigraineWorldSummit talk on racial inequities in migraine treatment, I was reminded that everything I've gone through on my treatment journey for #migraine is far worse, and more common, for Black migraineurs due to systemic racism. 
#BlackLivesMatter https://t.co/yWn9fOj0UK

The testimony in this trial is horrifying. And even if Chauvin is convicted, the system that enabled him to take a Black man's life has not yet been reformed. We all want justice. But one officer's conviction must be only the beginning. #BlackLivesMatter
 https://t.co/Bng2lT6aPS

Marvin Scott III died in jail hours after a minor pot arrest. The only thing that has happened so far? Those responsible have been fired. That’s it. A Black man was having a mental health crisis. And he was killed for it. #BlackLivesMatter  https://t.co/RahVts5fB0

Makiyah Bryant. Another name. Another Black person killed by police. She was only 15 years old.
#BlackLivesMatter  https://t.co/l3FnUFq9wK

Andrew Brown Jr. was unarmed and fleeing when fatally shot by North Carolina police, family attorney says.
#SayTheirNames
#BlackLivesMatter  https://t.co/jNdGfAcxQn

On May 24, I'll be attending a free bystander intervention training to help me better spot anti-Black racist harassment and learn how to support/intervene when it's appropriate to do so. Consider joining me. You can sign up at Hollaback. #BLM
